text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my way back from shopping, I see Curren Chan invite Admire Vega to a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm real tired… Let's take a break and get something sweet to eat. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm going home. Pass me my stuff.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're Ayabe's trainer! The two of us were just about to go and grab pancakes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I never agreed to that. We just bumped into each other by chance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I just can't get my mind off of pancakes. Look, even your trainer is making an "I want a pancake" face.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You are. So, let's go already! Pancaaakes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey, let go! Quit pulling me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Look at this pancake tower! ♪ The fruit decorations are so cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at the mountain of thick pancakes topped extravagantly with fruit and gourmet marshmallows.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now this is a treat worth splitting! Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's… so fluffy…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Exactly! The pancakes sold here are so airy, they just melt in your mouth!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This texture… it's so light on the palate. You just wind up eating more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pancake on Admire Vega's plate disappears in an instant.
choice_data_list: Try not to eat too much, okay?
Try not to eat too much, okay?
(I'll let her eat as much as she wants.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pancake on Admire Vega's plate disappears in an instant.
choice_data_list: Try not to eat too much, okay?
Try not to eat too much, okay?
(I'll let her eat as much as she wants.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well… of course, I was only planning to eat this one plate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Delicious…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! I knew you'd enjoy these fluffy pancakes, Ayabe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega carefully and slowly savors her reasonable serving of pancakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega is normally strict on herself. I think it would be good for her to indulge in something she enjoys every once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The bottom layers remind me of chiffon cake. They're really fluffy…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! I knew you'd enjoy these fluffy pancakes, Ayabe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although the tower of pancakes is meant to serve a group of people, Admire Vega ends up eating the majority of the stack.
